description: Operational dashboard for the media-processor worker and watcher. Covers workflow throughput and latency, transcode performance, the GPU-aware admission controller, workflow skips/errors, the watcher scan loop, and worker-fleet composition. Metric reference: docs/metrics.md.
title: Media Processor

panels.description: Workflows completed (closed) per second, across the selected namespaces and task queues.
panels.title: Workflow completion rate

panels.description: 95th-percentile wall-clock time from workflow start to close.
panels.title: Workflow p95 latency

panels.description: Aggregate output/input byte ratio over the selected window. Below 1.0 means transcoding is shrinking the corpus.
panels.title: Compression ratio (out / in)

panels.description: Fraction of transcodes that ran on a hardware encoder (QSV / VAAPI) rather than falling back to software.
panels.title: Hardware-accel rate

panels.description: Invalid files (unprobeable or no video stream) per second.
panels.title: Invalid file rate

panels.description: End-to-end workflow latency quantiles, derived from the Temporal SDK histogram.
panels.title: Workflow end-to-end latency

panels.description: Activity schedule-to-start latency — time an activity waits in the queue before a worker picks it up. Rising p95 is a leading indicator that worker capacity is saturated.
panels.title: Activity schedule-to-start latency (p95)

panels.description: Wall-clock transcode runtime quantiles, split by whether a hardware encoder was used. Sourced from media_workflow_transcode_duration_seconds (only emitted when an actual re-encode runs).
panels.title: Transcode duration by acceleration

panels.description: Transcode completion rate split by hardware vs software encoding.
panels.title: Transcode throughput

panels.description: Source vs destination file-size quantiles. The gap between the two lines is the per-file space saving.
panels.title: File size: source vs destination (p50)

panels.description: Share of transcode output by destination codec over the window.
panels.title: Output by destination codec

panels.description: Transcode completion rate per watch mapping.
panels.title: Transcodes by mapping

panels.description: Transcodes currently holding an admission slot, summed across transcode-capable workers.
panels.title: Slots in flight

panels.description: EWMA-smoothed load-probe reading in [0,1]: i915 GPU video-engine busy ratio on hardware-accelerated workers, container CPU utilization in software mode.
panels.title: Load utilization

panels.description: Rate of seconds reservations spend blocked on the admission controller before being admitted. Sustained values near or above 1 s/s mean transcodes are queuing for capacity.
panels.title: Admission blocked time

panels.description: Number of transcode-capable workers in each admission mode. 'static' means the load probe is unavailable and the supplier has fallen back to static-cap-only admission.
panels.title: Admission mode (workers per mode)

panels.description: Seconds remaining before each idle worker initiates an idle-exit drain. Only present when WORKER_IDLE_EXIT_AFTER is set. The timer is paused (held at its configured value) while work is in flight.
panels.title: Worker idle-exit countdown

panels.description: Non-fatal skip and error events. Import skips are expected operational outcomes (item removed, or library already holds a better file); invalid files and metrics errors warrant investigation if sustained.
panels.title: Skip & error event rates

panels.description: Most recent audio and subtitle track counts seen per media type / mapping (from the latest probe).
panels.title: Track counts (latest probe)

panels.description: Time since the most recent successful per-mapping scan. Climbing without bound means the watcher has stopped scanning successfully.
panels.title: Time since last successful scan

panels.description: Per-mapping scan completion rate, split by status. A rising 'error' series means directory walks are failing.
panels.title: Scan rate by status

panels.description: 95th-percentile per-mapping directory-walk duration.
panels.title: Scan duration (p95)

panels.description: Files discovered, workflow dispatches submitted, and dispatch failures. The gap between discovered and dispatched is files already processed or de-duplicated.
panels.title: Discovery & dispatch rates

panels.description: Number of worker pods that have each activity enabled. Derived from media_worker_activity_enabled, emitted on every worker.
panels.title: Worker pods per activity
